items.raw_excerpt: An abandoned church by Hai Ly Beach in the northern Vietnam's Ninh Binh Province, whose bell tower now stands next to the sea, has been recognized as a "climate change heritage tourism site."
items.summary_en: An old church near Hai Ly Beach in Ninh Binh Province has stood empty for many years. Its bell tower now sits close to the sea as the water rises. Vietnam has named the spot the country's first climate change heritage site.

items.raw_excerpt: Portugal is the country in the European Union where the population claims to practice sport the least, with 68% of respondents saying they never do so and only 4% exercising daily, according to a Eurobarometer survey.
items.summary_en: A Eurobarometer survey says Portugal has the lowest sport practice in the European Union. Sixty-eight percent of people in Portugal say they never do sport, and only four percent exercise every day. Portugal also has the smallest share of people who feel they are active.

items.raw_excerpt: People affected by cancer lose an average of €16,200 in annual income as a result of their diagnosis, the Irish Cancer Society has said.
items.summary_en: The Irish Cancer Society says people with cancer lose an average of 16,200 euros of yearly income after their diagnosis. The loss comes from long times away from work and extra costs during treatment. The charity says self-employed people and low paid workers suffer the most.

items.title_en: Cancer patients lose 16,200 euros of yearly income

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland households are in for a windfall when they receive their annual payment from their lines company.

items.raw_excerpt: Since 2019, Austria has guaranteed fathers and second parents the right to take a month off work after their child’s birth. Here’s how it works and what financial support is available.
